:::{#exr-zero-matrix-practice}
#### Naming a zero matrix

A [zero matrix](#def-zero-matrix) carries its shape in its subscript,
because, as @exm-zero-matrix shows,
[zero matrices](#def-zero-matrix) of different shapes are different [matrices](#def-matrix).
Let

$$
\matr{Z} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Find $m$ and $n$ such that $\matr{Z} = \matr{0}_{m \times n}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Count the [row](#def-matrix-row)s and [column](#def-matrix-column)s of $\matr{Z}$,
as in @exr-matrix-size-practice.

:::

:::
